title: Davinci-Tool: Scaling Agentic Tool-Use Supervision with Verifiable Executable Environments
abstract: arXiv:2610.16867v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable agentic tool use requires training data that pair diverse multi-step workflows with executable evidence that the requested outcomes were achieved. Scaling either trajectory coverage or verification alone is insufficient as new environments introduce distinct states, rules, and dependencies that must also be reflected in the success criteria. To address this challenge, we introduce Davinci-Tool, a 30B tool-use model, and Davinci-ToolData, an execution-grounded dataset designed to scale environment coverage and outcome verification together. Davinci-ToolData preserves restorable states, execution traces, outcomes, and verifiers as a unified substrate for supervision. translated_title: Davinci-Tool：利用可验证的可执行环境扩展智能体工具使用监督
translated_abstract: 可靠的智能体工具使用需要训练数据既包含多样化的多步骤工作流程，又配备可执行的证据来证明所要求的结果已达成。单独扩展轨迹覆盖范围或验证能力都是不够的，因为新环境会引入独特的状态、规则和依赖关系，这些也必须反映在成功标准中。为应对这一挑战，我们推出了 Davinci-Tool（一个 30B 参数的工具使用模型）以及 Davinci-ToolData（一个以执行为基础的数据集，旨在同时扩展环境覆盖范围与结果验证能力）。Davinci-ToolData 将可恢复的状态、执行轨迹、执行结果和验证器保存为统一的监督基础。两条互补的流水线用于填充这一基础：执行导向任务合成（EGTS）从独立编写的系统中推导出经过验证的示范，而可执行环境合成（EES）则合成可审计的环境、基于状态的任务（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出 30B 参数工具使用模型 Davinci-Tool 及执行导向数据集 Davinci-ToolData，通过 EGTS 和 EES 两条互补流水线同时扩展环境覆盖与结果验证，为智能体工具使用提供可验证的可执行监督数据。
en_tdlr: Davinci-Tool is a 30B tool-use model trained on Davinci-ToolData, an execution-grounded dataset that jointly scales environment coverage and outcome verification through two complementary pipelines (EGTS and EES), providing verifiable executable supervision for agentic tool use.
